values.description: Individual measurement values plotted on the Individuals (I) chart. Bind to your sample data.

subgroupSize.description: Subgroup size for the control chart (1 = Individuals & Moving Range).

showUCL.description: Show the Upper Control Limit (UCL) markline.

showLCL.description: Show the Lower Control Limit (LCL) markline.

showCenterLine.description: Show the Center Line (process mean) markline.

showMRChart.description: Show the Moving Range (MR) chart below the Individuals chart.

showRunRules.description: Highlight points violating run rules (out of limits, or 8-in-a-row on one side of the mean).

title.description: Chart title. Leave blank for the default title.

option.description: Advanced override. If non-empty, this ECharts option is used verbatim and the domain props above are ignored.
